changes: Deleted the legacy-koala backward-compat/migration layer from 12 product files: the legacy activity.legacy-koala.jsonl archive reader (activity-log.ts/lattice-paths.ts), the KOALA_ env-var fallbacks (KOALA_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS, KOALA_USAGE_LEDGER, KOALA_ in dispatch-runner passlist), the legacy-koala write-path guards (assertNoLegacyKoalaWritePath/containsLegacyKoalaDir/isLegacyKoalaWritePath in lattice-paths/prewrite-guard/config/dev-memory), the managed-assets koala:internal + koala-*.md cleanup, and the (?:koala|lattice) dual-accept regexes (now lattice-only).
usage: No new user command — this is a ship-clean refactor. Old koala installs lose auto-migration: LATTICE_ env vars and lattice doc markers are now the only accepted path; the koala-residue gate stays PASS.
expectedOutcome: A maintainer running 'git grep -nE LegacyKoala|KOALA_|legacy-koala packages/*/src' sees zero hits except handlers/review-preflight.ts; tsc clean; node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs PASS.
actualTranscript: git grep residue: 0 hits outside review-preflight.ts; verify-koala-residue.mjs PASS 0 unclassified + self-test 5/5; tsc --noEmit exit 0; lattice validate PASS; 47/47 verificationIntents passing.
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match exactly.
limitations: Scoped to product code; the review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_* gate wiring, the koala-<role> lane tokens, and docs/experiments are deferred to stories 3-4; old-koala migration support is intentionally dropped per the user no-compat directive.
pitfalls: Original premise was wrong (koala already de-branded; remainder was gate-classified compat) — re-scoped after discovery. Assurance floor needed degraded 3x1 (Authority off) and EVERY host verdict must carry all 4 binding fields (materialDigest+storyFilesHash+validationDigest+promptDigest) — missing promptDigest silently moved verdicts to ignoredVerdicts (0/3). Whole-tree materialHash drifts on concurrent main-merges; bind storyFilesHash + re-attest.
